# Vatican City State

> > Official government portal of Vatican City State, the world's smallest sovereign state and spiritual center of the Catholic Church.

This site serves as the primary digital gateway to the Governatorate of Vatican City State, providing information about state institutions, museums, gardens, and administrative services. It represents the temporal governance structure of the Holy See and its territorial sovereignty.

## Key Topics

- Vatican City State
- Holy See
- Governatorate
- Vatican Museums
- Vatican Gardens
- Gendarmerie Corps
- Fire Brigade
- Pontifical Villas
- Castel Gandolfo
- Astronomical Observatory
- Laudato Si'
- State Administration
- Diplomatic Relations
- Legislation
- Government Structure

## Main Portal

- [Vatican State](https://www.vaticanstate.va/en/): Official homepage of Vatican City State and Holy See government portal
- [Vatican State](https://vaticanstate.va/): Main Vatican State portal covering government, museums, and services

## Optional

- [Vaticano Webmail Sign In](https://autodiscover.vaticanstate.va/): Internal Zimbra webmail login for Vatican telecommunications staff
